'''"Red Hand" Magaran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|gun runner]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point around [[3641 BBY]] he made a deal with [[Tanno Vik]] to provide him a shipment of guns. Vik chose another buyer instead and after Magaran sent bounty hunters after Vik, Vik simply killed him in his Nar Shaddaa office.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red Hand Magaran appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during several of Tanno Vik's companion quests.
